as_told.title: Sent to the National Press Club to red-team whistleblowers

plain: Jake Barber, who says he helped recover a UFO by helicopter, says that in 2023 he went to a whistleblower conference at the National Press Club in Washington, hosted by Steven Greer, shortly after a law protecting whistleblowers took effect, and heard Michael Herrera tell his story there. Barber says he was sent by his employer to look for whistleblowers, essentially to test them from the other side, and the podcast host Jesse Michels later put it to Greer as Barber having come to infiltrate his camp. If true, it would mean people inside the secret world were watching who was coming forward.
